_auth_options.broker: Windows WAM sign-in, delegated. Results are permission-trimmed to the signed-in user. Use this.
_auth_options.interactive: Browser redirect, delegated. Fallback if WAM misbehaves.
_auth_options.service-principal: App-only client secret. Names client_secret_env; value lives in .env.
_auth_options._warning: App-only modes read every site the app is granted. Nothing is permission-trimmed - anyone using the agent sees everything the app can see. Use Sites.Selected with explicit per-site grants if you must.
